scripts.text:
Declare @Filename varchar(1000) = @0

 INSERT INTO [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_RunLog]  (ProcessName, FileName, ProcessDate)
 Values ('CreateStateExtract',@Filename, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

 select @@Identity RunLogID

Declare @RunLogID INT

SELECT @RunLogID = ISNULL(MAX(RunLogID),0) FROM [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_RunLog]
WHERE ProcessName = 'CreateStateExtract' AND [Status] = 'Completed'


DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #CreateExtractFile
CREATE TABLE #CreateExtractFile (
	[TRACKING_ID] varchar(30),[MCE_CLAIM_ID] varchar(30),[FORM_TYPE] varchar(4),[BILL_TYPE] varchar(4),[CLAIM_STATUS] varchar(2),[CLAIM_REASON] varchar(30),[CLAIM_PROV_ID] varchar(15),[CLAIM_MEM_ID] varchar(25),[PAT_CTRL_NUM] varchar(30),[HEADER_BILLED_AMT] decimal(13,2),[STATUS_DETAIL_LINE] varchar(2),[REASON_DETAIL_LINE] varchar(30),[CLAIM_START_DT] varchar(10),[CLAIM_END_DT] varchar(10),[CLAIM_PAID_AMT] decimal(13,2),[CLAIM_LINE_NUM] int,[CLAIM_SERV_CODE] varchar(5),[MOD_CODE1] varchar(2),[MOD_CODE2] varchar(2),[REV_CODE] varchar(4),[SERV_UNITS] int,[CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT] decimal(13,2),[CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT] decimal(13,2)
) 

INSERT INTO #CreateExtractFile
SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(TRACKING_ID))			as TRACKING_ID		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([MCE_CLAIM_ID]))			as [MCE_CLAIM_ID]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([FORM_TYPE]))			as [FORM_TYPE]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([BILL_TYPE]))			as [BILL_TYPE]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([CLAIM_STATUS]))			as [CLAIM_STATUS]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([CLAIM_REASON]))			as [CLAIM_REASON]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([CLAIM_PROV_ID]))		as [CLAIM_PROV_ID]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([CLAIM_MEM_ID]))			as [CLAIM_MEM_ID]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([PAT_CTRL_NUM]))			as [PAT_CTRL_NUM]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([HEADER_BILLED_AMT]))	as [HEADER_BILLED_AMT]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([STATUS_DETAIL_LINE]))	as [STATUS_DETAIL_LINE]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([REASON_DETAIL_LINE]))	as [REASON_DETAIL_LINE]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([CLAIM_START_DT]))		as [CLAIM_START_DT]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([CLAIM_END_DT]))			as [CLAIM_END_DT]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([CLAIM_PAID_AMT]))		as [CLAIM_PAID_AMT]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([CLAIM_LINE_NUM]))		as [CLAIM_LINE_NUM]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([CLAIM_SERV_CODE]))		as [CLAIM_SERV_CODE]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([MOD_CODE1]))			as [MOD_CODE1]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([MOD_CODE2]))			as [MOD_CODE2]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([REV_CODE]))				as [REV_CODE]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([SERV_UNITS]))			as [SERV_UNITS]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM([CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT]))		as [CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT]		
      ,LTRIM(RTRIM(CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT))  as [CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT]		
       From [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_State]
	   WHERE RunLogID > @RunLogID

/* Outbound File Format */

DECLARE @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST VARCHAR(MAX), @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST_qry NVARCHAR(MAX),
		@V_DATA_FIELD_LIST VARCHAR(MAX), @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST_qry NVARCHAR(MAX),
		@SQL VARCHAR(MAX),
		@TableName VARCHAR(100) = '#CreateExtractFile', 
		@Delimiter VARCHAR(1) ='|'


SET @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST_qry =
	N'SELECT @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST = STUFF(
			(  SELECT '''+@Delimiter+''' + C.name + '''' FROM TEMPDB.sys.columns C WHERE C.object_id = T.object_id ORDER BY C.column_id FOR XML PATH('''')
		), 1, 1, '''')
	FROM TEMPDB.sys.tables T
	WHERE T.OBJECT_ID = ( SELECT OBJECT_ID(''TEMPDB..'+@TableName+'''))'

EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST_qry , N'@V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT', @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST OUTPUT;



SET @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST_qry =
	N'SELECT @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST = STUFF(
			( SELECT '' + ''''@Delimiter'''' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),['' + C.name + '']),'''''''')'' FROM TEMPDB.sys.columns C
		WHERE C.object_id = T.object_id ORDER BY C.column_id FOR XML PATH('''')
		), 1, 18, '''')
	FROM TEMPDB.sys.tables T
	WHERE T.OBJECT_ID = ( SELECT OBJECT_ID(''TEMPDB..'+@TableName+'''))'

EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST_qry , N'@V_DATA_FIELD_LIST NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT', @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST OUTPUT;
SET @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST = REPLACE(@V_DATA_FIELD_LIST, '@Delimiter', @Delimiter)


IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..##DX_OH_PandPStateExtract_RESULTSET') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##DX_OH_PandPStateExtract_RESULTSET
CREATE TABLE ##DX_OH_PandPStateExtract_RESULTSET (RecordType INT, ResultSet VARCHAR(MAX))

SET @SQL = '
INSERT INTO ##DX_OH_PandPStateExtract_RESULTSET
SELECT 1 RecordType, ''' + @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST + ''' as resultset

INSERT INTO ##DX_OH_PandPStateExtract_RESULTSET
SELECT 2 RecordType, ' + @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST + ' as resultset
FROM  #CreateExtractFile'

EXEC (@SQL)

Declare @RunLogID INT = @RunLogID

Update [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_RunLog] set [Status] = 'Completed' where RunLogID = @RunLogID

FinalFileResultQry.defaultValue: 'SELECT cast( ResultSet as varchar(max)) ResultSet FROM ##DX_OH_PandPStateExtract_RESULTSET ORDER BY RecordType'
